statement: For each fixed gamma in (0,2), the h-dependent random Borel set T_h^gamma refutes an extension of independent-set metric KPZ to all random Borel sets: its Euclidean dimension is 2-gamma^2/2 and metric dimension d_gamma, whereas the unrestricted equality would predict 2.
assumptions: published thick-point dimension and full-dimension corollary
proof_or_counterexample: Source Eq. (1.11) with ambient C and Cor. 1.7 give the two dimensions on one fixed-gamma probability-one event. Substitution into the wrongly extended KPZ equality gives xi Q d_gamma -xi^2 d_gamma^2/2=gamma Q-gamma^2/2=2, exceeding actual Euclidean dimension by gamma^2/2. At gamma^2=8/3 the gap is 4/3.
